query:
CREATE TABLE `meter_readings` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`roomId` int NOT NULL,
	`tenantId` int,
	`type` enum('water','electricity') NOT NULL,
	`previousReading` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL,
	`currentReading` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL,
	`unitsUsed` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL,
	`readingDate` date NOT NULL,
	`billingPeriod` varchar(7),
	`imageUrl` text,
	`ocrRawValue` varchar(50),
	`notes` text,
	`recordedBy` int,
	`createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	CONSTRAINT `meter_readings_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`),
	CONSTRAINT `meter_readings_roomId_rooms_id_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`roomId`) REFERENCES `rooms`(`id`),
	CONSTRAINT `meter_readings_tenantId_tenants_id_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`tenantId`) REFERENCES `tenants`(`id`),
	CONSTRAINT `meter_readings_recordedBy_users_id_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`recordedBy`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`)
)
